label: Greek-taught places at a public university: the ministry's foreign-nationals route, 2027

readerAccess.reason: At least one parent is not of Greek descent. You also need a B2 Greek certificate to enrol.

milestones.label: Ministry application window (eight days)
milestones.note: In 2026 it ran 2 to 9 July, with documents by courier on 10 July. The ministry announces it a day or so before it opens; watch minedu.gov.gr from late June 2027.

milestones.label: Enrolment at the department, with the B2 Greek certificate

submissionItems.label: Greek language certificate at B2
submissionItems.note: From the University of Athens, the University of Thessaloniki or the Centre for the Greek Language. Without it you enrol a year later, or lose the place.

supplementarySteps: This is the route into Greek-taught programmes, not English-taught ones. For those, apply to the programme directly.
Have every document and its official Greek translation ready in June. The window is eight days and falls in IB results week.

notes: The ministry's circular files a graduate of an EU-member-state school under category B1 of the same special category as non-EU foreign nationals. The Panhellenic exams are not the route.
Not established: how an IB applicant is ranked for a place, and whether the Athens School of Fine Arts takes applicants through this route.
